title: The Work queue's batch strip says when a batch is live; ?tab= lands on any tab the board has
why: Jason, 2026-11-26 (through the session manager): the Development strip still said "4 releases waiting for your OK" for a batch he approved in chat and that went live (#293 to #297), and ?tab=development seemed to open the Board. Now each release of the batch that's live is marked "Live as #N"; when all are, the strip says "Every release in it is live" and asks nothing (no Approve the batch); an older batch that's all live is neither shown nor emailed (ControlGauges::latestBatch, ControlGauges::batchLive); one rolled back asks again. And ?tab= accepts any tab the board draws a part for, or has a button for anywhere on the page, not only a button inside the board, so it never depends on where the side menu puts its buttons (since config-rail, #291). Admin only, no table, no outside call.
